verdicts.evidence: IOBoard.md:141 (Clock accuracy) and :199 (Controller clock) give only the 40 MHz frequency and SPI-clock reason, not load capacitance, ESR, drive level, shunt C0, cut/mode or any oscillator spec; Pins.md:160-161 states only the SPI-clock relationship; Research.md:570 (the Follow-ups row) cites only V26/V27, which (Research.md:722-723) ask solely for frequency error in ppm, still 'for research'. No V-number anywhere gives the crystal/resonator/oscillator electrical limits this question asks for. (Note: the critic's comparison is slightly off since R1's analogous V6 for the 12 MHz crystal is itself still 'for research', not answered as claimed — only V15 is answered — but that inaccuracy doesn't change that the CAN-clock figures are genuinely missing.)

Monostable.md step 11 ('The corners') reads: 'steps 7 and 10 at 25 °C and 3.3 V, and at 0 °C and 50 °C each at 3.2 V and 3.4 V' — it names only steps 7 and 10, not step 9 ('The switches and the rails'). V38 (Research.md:734) asks the ambient range for 'the safety gate and the ESC pack switches' and is still 'for research'; it also does not ask about supply-voltage range, nor explicitly about the external module or the clamp. So no existing question covers the full ambient+supply corner set for the replacement MOSFET array, module and clamp.

V49 (Research.md:745) already has an owner decision: '7 W for the switch array at 150 A, RDS(on) taken at TJ 100 °C...(owner, 2026-09-28)'. Since this value is already answered, it is not an open question for the owner — re-adding it as a new raised question is a duplicate of an already-decided V-number; any gap is in carrying the figure into P1's value table, not in needing a new question.

That part of the gap is real and uncovered.

Correcting IOBoard.md:473's sourcing tag is a page-writing (P7) concern, not grounds for a new raised question when V181 already covers the substance and is still open.

Sensing.md:109 states the ADCS7476 shares an SPI controller with the CAN controllers and the load-cell ADC, and that 'Its conversion trigger on the index pulse's timebase is not confirmed in the returns'. IOBoard.md:118/489 record a newer owner decision (2026-09-30) that the measurement coprocessor now samples the accelerometer ADC and the index pulse on one shared timebase of its own. V202 (Research.md:898, R10's own phase-error question) is still 'for research', and V225's owner answer (2026-09-28, Research.md:921) giving 2.54 µs/16.7 µs predates that 2026-09-30 timebase decision and the SPI-sharing detail, so it does not visibly account for SPI-arbitration or shared-timebase clock/timer jitter. The specific budget-share question, inclusive of these newer facts, is not answered anywhere.

IOBoard.md:529 states: 'Whether the magnetic pickup and phase-wire clip readings use MOTOR_POLES: not stated in the tree (R11).' V218 (Research.md:914) asks the pulses-per-revolution/MOTOR_POLES question only for the magnetic pickup; a search of Research.md's phase-wire clip V-numbers (V211, V214-216, V229) finds none asking this for the phase-wire clip. Genuine, uncovered gap.
